2026-06-08 — Post-v1.1.0 maintenance + v1.1.1 SHIPPED. All prior-handoff items cleared.

v1.1.1 SHIPPED (parity-completeness patch): #121 unified `rvr init`'s CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md onto a shared core (REVERIE_CORE_GUIDE) that names both surfaces — prefer MCP, fall back to CLI with identical functionality; the MCP handshake blob (DEFAULT_LLM_INSTRUCTIONS) now states CLI parity too. Released via tag v1.1.1: workflow fully green, GitHub Release + 4 binaries live, tap formula auto-bumped to 1.1.1. #121 closed.

KEY WIN: HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN rotation is PROVEN — the v1.1.1 "Update Homebrew Tap" job succeeded (v1.1.0's had failed on the expired PAT). Releases self-serve again. Deploy-key #123 remains as the durable fix to avoid the ≤1yr PAT-expiry recurrence (not urgent).

ALSO DONE THIS SESSION: store hygiene — pruned/compressed historical project.* (~35KB→~21KB), rewrote project.inFlight current+lean. Filed #121 (done), #122 (project.* never-shed → route through #84), #123 (deploy key). Added archived-lifecycle spec to #84 (chosen over an _archive/ folder; git + docs/ are the history layer).

UNCOMMITTED: this entry + project.inFlight (.reverie store updates) not yet committed to git.

NEXT (no urgent items): WS3 #119; v1.15 search theme (#13/#43, user-flagged); #84 entry-health design (carries archived-state spec); #123 deploy-key when convenient.
